title.original: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
title.zh: EvoAgentX：用于演进智能体工作流的自动化框架
title.en: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows

inclusion_reason.zh: EvoAgentX 以统一五层运行时承载工作流生成、执行、进化和评测，并提供可替换的多 Agent 优化器接口。
inclusion_reason.en: EvoAgentX supplies a common five-layer runtime for workflow generation, execution, evolution, and evaluation with swappable multi-agent optimizer interfaces.

abstract.zh: EvoAgentX 是自动生成、执行并进化优化多 Agent 工作流的开源平台。其五层模块化架构把基础组件、Agent、工作流、进化算法和评测解耦，并集成 TextGrad、AFlow 与 MIPRO 来迭代修改提示、工具配置和拓扑。
abstract.en: EvoAgentX is an open platform for generating, executing, and evolutionarily optimizing multi-agent workflows. Its five-layer architecture separates components, agents, workflows, evolution, and evaluation, integrating TextGrad, AFlow, and MIPRO to refine prompts, tools, and topology.

problem.zh: 多 Agent 框架通常依赖人工配置，优化算法又分散在独立实现中，导致工作流难以持续演化或在统一运行时中比较优化策略。
problem.en: Multi-agent frameworks usually require manual configuration, while optimization algorithms live in isolated implementations, preventing continuous evolution and controlled comparison within one runtime.

approach.zh: 平台把提示、工具和工作流图表示为可变配置，以评测反馈驱动选定优化器提出新版本，再由统一执行与评估层闭环比较。
approach.en: The platform represents prompts, tools, and workflow graphs as mutable configurations, lets a chosen optimizer propose revisions from evaluation feedback, and compares versions through common execution and evaluation layers.

system_design.zh: 五层栈自下而上提供组件接口、Agent 封装、工作流图执行、进化算法适配和任务评测；优化层可替换而不改变底层 Agent 与执行契约。
system_design.en: Five layers provide component interfaces, agent wrappers, graph execution, optimizer adapters, and task evaluation. Evolution algorithms are swappable without changing the underlying agent or runtime contract.

key_results.zh: 在 HotPotQA、MBPP、MATH 和 GAIA 上，进化后的工作流被报告在多跳问答、代码、数学与真实任务中持续优于初始配置。
key_results.en: On HotPotQA, MBPP, MATH, and GAIA, evolved workflows are reported to consistently improve over initial configurations across reasoning, coding, mathematics, and real-world tasks.

limitations.zh: 进化质量受评测集和搜索预算约束，反复调用 LLM 的成本可能较高；基准上的拓扑改进也可能过拟合，摘要未讨论安全约束或线上回滚。
limitations.en: Evolution is bounded by benchmark feedback and search budget and can require many LLM calls; optimized topologies may overfit, while safety constraints and online rollback are not covered in the abstract.

notes.zh: 四项基准和四个改进值来自官方摘要；底座模型、硬件、优化预算及 TextGrad/AFlow/MIPRO 分项结果待全文审计。
notes.en: Four benchmarks and four improvement values come from the official abstract; base models, hardware, optimization budget, and per-optimizer results await full-text audit.
